subject: 绿色生态环保：一滴雨穿过湿地、河流与城市雨水花园的循环叙事
audience: 关心气候、城市生态与日常可持续行动的公众和社区行动者
page_job: 理解生态修复是一条可进入的水循环，并选择一种低门槛行动

art_direction.thesis: 把网页拍成一页会呼吸的田野笔记：真实水、风、雾、植被与城市排水影像主导，文字只在测量过的空场留下墨迹。
art_direction.signature: 湿地全屏影像上的龙藏体双行中文题字，以及贯穿章节的细水线。
art_direction.selected_type: Long Cang signature + Ma Shan Zheng support display + Source Han Sans SC reading; distributed expressive Chinese
art_direction.selected_layout: Chaptered immersion with full-bleed Hero, pale recovery, full-viewport media chapters and ruled action rows
art_direction.selected_color: Peat / fog / living signal: #0B1712, #E8E6D8 and restrained #B8E36A

hero_contract.subject_safe_zone: desktop x=58–94%, y=28–88%; phone right/middle field preserved by object-position 53% 50%
hero_contract.interaction_safe_zone: desktop left x=5–44% below title; phone top/bottom edges outside bird flight path
hero_contract.mobile_transformation: Keep a 100svh full-bleed media field; place the two-line title in the upper-left fog band and shift the validated crop to 53% so moving birds/reeds remain visible at right rather than shrinking media.

hero_subject_signals: shallow wetland water with expanding ripples
mist and reflected dawn light changing over time

type.reading: Source Han Sans SC, PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
type.utility: Source Han Sans SC, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

sections.purpose: 建立一滴雨回到生态循环的页面命题
sections.content_source: 原创编辑文案 + accepted SenseAudio hero-wetland text-to-video asset
sections.layout: 100svh full-bleed video with left-edge copy field and fixed transparent navigation

responsive.phone: title in upper-left fog band; media remains 100svh at object-position 53%

sections.reduced_motion: Show hero poster and all copy; explicit media button may reveal/play the native video.

sections.purpose: 解释慢下来、停留与渗透作为生态起点
sections.content_source: 原创编辑文案，描述 Hero 影像中可见的水、芦苇和浅滩关系
sections.layout: fog-bone recovery field with wide title, narrow body and a dark quote band
sections.surface_role: pale recovery then dark typographic echo

responsive.phone: single column with authored two-line title

sections.reduced_motion: Copy and waterline are visible without reveal transforms.

sections.purpose: 让连接、绕行和连续水体成为可见机制
sections.content_source: 原创编辑文案 + accepted SenseAudio river-memory text-to-video asset
sections.layout: 100svh full-bleed media chapter with an upper-left observation rail; sticky tail removed after full-page QA
sections.safe_zone: copy x=4–38%, y=10–42%; primary current remains visible across center/right

responsive.phone: 78svh full-width media, copy in lower/left band

sections.reduced_motion: Poster and text remain in the same normal-flow full-bleed composition.

sections.purpose: 把生态循环连接到城市日常空间
sections.content_source: 原创编辑文案 + accepted SenseAudio city-rain-garden text-to-video asset
sections.layout: 110svh full-bleed video with left concrete-field copy and marginal handwritten note
sections.safe_zone: copy x=4–44%, y=16–64%; rain garden subject x=52–92%, y=42–92%

responsive.phone: 100svh full media at object-position 70%; compact left/top copy

sections.reduced_motion: City poster remains visible; note and body are static.

sections.purpose: 提供三项无需虚构数字的低门槛生态行动
sections.content_source: 原创通用行动建议：减少硬铺、乡土植物、雨水就地渗透
sections.layout: fog-bone field with three edge-to-edge ruled ordered rows
sections.reduced_motion: Hover shifts removed; focus and all copy remain visible.

sections.purpose: 安静收束并允许访客回到源头
sections.content_source: 原创编辑文案与内部回顶链接
sections.layout: peat footer with large brand echo and a single return anchor
sections.reduced_motion: No ambient motion; return anchor remains functional.

short.transform: compact vertical gaps and type scale without changing full-bleed media mode
